mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary policy cycle, reducing discount rates on equity cash flows and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in the unemployment rate above 6.5% triggers a loss of investor confidence, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not negative despite UNRATE crossing above 6.5% in the trigger period.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in economic demand (GDPC1) and rising federal funds rates signal conflicting policy signals, creating market uncertainty and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: both GDPC1 and FEDFUNDS rise in the same month
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are not negative when both proxies rise in the same month.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion phase marked by slowing demand growth (GDPC1 deceleration below 2% MoM), investor sentiment turns cautious, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 growth rate < 2% MoM in the last quarter
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not negative during periods of GDPC1 deceleration below 2% MoM.

mechanism_narrative: Weak supply growth (INDPRO decline) coupled with strong labor demand (PAYEMS surge) creates inflationary pressures, prompting S&P 500 gains over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO falls while PAYEMS rises in the same month
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not positive when both proxies move in tandem.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp decline in housing demand (HOUST < 800 units) signals a contraction in the housing market, reducing consumer spending and triggering negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are not negative within 1 trading day of the trigger.

mechanism_narrative: Persistent inflation (CPIAUCSL rising) erodes real returns on equities, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are not negative during periods of sustained CPIAUCSL increases.

mechanism_narrative: Strong economic demand (GDPC1 growth) alongside falling unemployment (UNRATE decline) creates a favorable macro environment, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 rises and UNRATE falls in the same month
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not positive when both proxies move in tandem.
